question: Does a current NanoClaw Agent Template use plugin.json at the template root as its discovery marker?

hypotheses.h1: Current NanoClaw templates use plugin.json at the template root.

decisiveTest.name: Inspect the current ForkCheck template root and official NanoClaw template contract
decisiveTest.method: Read the root manifest and compare its schema/path to the current template parser contract.

expectedByHypothesis.h1: A root plugin.json is present and accepted as the discovery marker.
expectedByHypothesis.h2: The root file is absent or rejected in favor of .codex-plugin/plugin.json.

evidence.title: ForkCheck Agent Plugins 1.0.0 manifest
evidence.finding: The conformant manifest is plugin.json at the template root and declares the Agent Plugins 1.0.0 schema.
limitations: This fixture demonstrates the checked-in current template; registry rules should be rechecked if the standard changes.

observation: A root plugin.json exists and is the discovery manifest used by the current template.
limitations: Agent Plugins clients outside NanoClaw may also support product-specific installation layouts.
